summary.headline: Afflicting Signs and Planetary Exaltations
summary.text: Astrological discussion of bodily afflictions and sign qualities: signs producing leprosy, vitiligo, scabs, licentiousness, and eye injuries, with references to the Pleiades, the little cloud, the sting, the point, the spine, and the urn. It then explains the exaltations and depressions of the Sun and Saturn through their opposing associations with light, fire, darkness, night, and cold.
